equation_or_definition: V = voxel count in mask M
rationale: Primary 3D size measure (regionprops 'area' in 3D = volume)

equation_or_definition: V_filled = voxel count with internal 3D holes filled
rationale: Detects internal voids versus true cell volume
Scale-invariant size metric; diameter of volume-equivalent sphere

equation_or_definition: V / V_bbox
rationale: Fill fraction of bounding box; low for sparse or elongated cells

equation_or_definition: chi = C - H (connected components minus holes)
rationale: Topological genus; non-unity flags shredded or holed masks

equation_or_definition: V_bbox = b_z * b_y * b_x
rationale: Reference scale for compactness and extent family

equation_or_definition: (4 * pi * r_eq^2) / S_bbox where r_eq = D_eq / 2, S_bbox = 2(b_z b_y + b_y b_x + b_z b_x)
rationale: Fast bbox-surface-based sphericity proxy

equation_or_definition: max(b_z, b_y, b_x) / min(b_z, b_y, b_x)
rationale: Bbox-frame elongation

equation_or_definition: V / V_bbox
rationale: Numerically identical to extent (misnamed; true compactness would be (36 pi V^2) / S^3). Excluded from PCA_FEATURES and morphospace PCA. Still emitted by extract_features for backward-compat with existing CSVs.

equation_or_definition: C_d = (n - A_v / 6) / (n - n^(2/3)) where n = voxel count and A_v = total external face count
rationale: Bribiesca (Pattern Recognition 2008) discrete compactness. Bounded [0, 1]: 1 = perfect cube, sphere ~0.85, thin rod = low. Genuinely orthogonal to true_sphericity (uses voxel face counts, not marching-cubes surface area) so it captures voxel-scale shape complexity. Useful as both a real shape descriptor and a soft segmentation-quality signal.

equation_or_definition: b_z
rationale: Cell height along apical-basal axis

equation_or_definition: b_z / max(b_y, b_x)
rationale: Columnar-ness; greater than 1 is tall, less than 1 is flat

equation_or_definition: max(b_y, b_x) / min(b_y, b_x)
rationale: Lateral elongation (polarized versus round in-plane)

equation_or_definition: V / V_filled
rationale: Less than 1 indicates internal voxel holes inside the label

equation_or_definition: V / V_ell where V_ell = (4/3) pi sqrt(a^2 b^2 c^2); semi-axes from inertia eigenvalues: a^2 = 5/2 (I_0 + I_1 - I_2), b^2 = 5/2 (I_0 - I_1 + I_2), c^2 = 5/2 (-I_0 + I_1 + I_2)
rationale: Deviation from best-fit solid ellipsoid

equation_or_definition: sqrt(I_0 / I_2)
rationale: Direction-independent aspect ratio from inertia eigenvalues

equation_or_definition: sqrt(I_1 / I_0)
rationale: Oblate (flat) vs prolate (rod) discriminator

equation_or_definition: 2 * sqrt(a^2) where a is largest ellipsoid semi-axis
rationale: Length of longest principal ellipsoid axis

equation_or_definition: 2 * sqrt(c^2) where c is smallest ellipsoid semi-axis
rationale: Length of shortest principal ellipsoid axis

equation_or_definition: arccos(|v_major . z_hat|) in degrees where v_major is the eigenvector of smallest inertia eigenvalue
rationale: Principal-axis tilt relative to Z (0 deg = columnar, 90 deg = in-plane)

equation_or_definition: SA via 3D marching cubes (skimage.measure.mesh_surface_area) on padded binary crop
rationale: Geometry orthogonal to volume measurement
Gold-standard Wadell sphericity; 1 for a perfect sphere

equation_or_definition: SA / SA_eq_sphere where SA_eq_sphere = 4 pi r_eq^2 with r_eq = (3V / 4 pi)^(1/3)
rationale: Boundary convolution; 1 = smooth sphere, greater than 1 = rough surface

equation_or_definition: V / V_hull via convex hull (regionprops in enrich_expensive_features, or subsampled hull in compute_surface_features)
rationale: Convex deficiency; low = lobed or fragmented shape

equation_or_definition: Count of medial-axis voxels (local maxima of 3D EDT with dt greater than 1)
rationale: Internal path length proxy

equation_or_definition: (# branch points with more than 2 skeleton neighbours in 26-connectivity) + 1
rationale: Merged cells form dumbbell skeletons with multiple branches

equation_or_definition: # branch points only (no +1)
rationale: Raw bifurcation count

equation_or_definition: mean A(z) over bottom 20% of cell Z-range (A(z) = #mask voxels in slice z)
rationale: Wide base indicates pyramidal or basal cell

equation_or_definition: mean A(z) over top 20% of cell Z-range
rationale: Wide top indicates squamous or apical cell

equation_or_definition: apical_area / basal_area
rationale: Less than 0.5 = pyramidal; about 1 = columnar; greater than 2 = inverted

equation_or_definition: (argmax_z A(z) - z_min) / (z_max - z_min)
rationale: Position of widest slice (0 = base, 1 = apex)

equation_or_definition: OLS slope of A(z) versus normalized z (sign flipped if invert_z)
rationale: Signed tapering rate along Z

equation_or_definition: RMS residual of linear fit of A(z) versus z, normalized by mean area
rationale: Non-linear profile (barrel, vase, dumbbell shape)

equation_or_definition: mean intensity over mask voxels
rationale: Overall fluorescence signal level

equation_or_definition: std intensity over mask voxels
rationale: Signal heterogeneity

equation_or_definition: min intensity over mask voxels
rationale: Dim tail of intra-cell distribution

equation_or_definition: max intensity over mask voxels
rationale: Bright tail of intra-cell distribution

equation_or_definition: mean intensity on 2-voxel erosion shell (boundary = M AND NOT erode(M, 2))
rationale: Membrane-bright signature in membrane-GFP channel

equation_or_definition: mean intensity on erosion core (erode(M, 2))
rationale: Should be dark for correctly segmented membrane-marked cells

equation_or_definition: boundary_intensity_mean / interior_intensity_mean (denominator floor 1e-6)
rationale: Merged cells show reduced contrast; correct cells have bright membrane rim

equation_or_definition: std of per-slice mean intensity across cell Z-range
rationale: Axial signal instability indicative of reconstruction artifacts

equation_or_definition: mean channel intensity over mask voxels (added per user-named channel in Extract Features dialog)
rationale: Independent signal check; plotting nucleus channel mean vs area separates real cells (present nucleus) from spurious / merged / fragment masks (absent or weak nucleus signal)

equation_or_definition: median channel intensity over mask voxels
rationale: Outlier-robust signal level

equation_or_definition: std of channel intensity over mask voxels
rationale: Intra-cell signal heterogeneity

equation_or_definition: min channel intensity over mask voxels
rationale: Dim tail of intra-cell distribution

equation_or_definition: max channel intensity over mask voxels
rationale: Bright tail of intra-cell distribution

equation_or_definition: sum of channel intensity over mask voxels
rationale: Integrated signal (scales with cell volume)

equation_or_definition: intensity_std / intensity_mean (0 if mean = 0)
rationale: Signal variability normalized by level

equation_or_definition: mean channel intensity on 2-voxel erosion shell
rationale: Channel signal at the cell boundary (useful for membrane-like markers)

equation_or_definition: mean channel intensity on erosion core
rationale: Channel signal in the cell interior (useful for nuclear / cytoplasmic markers; nuclei signal here is the key QC discriminator for detecting masks that don't contain a nucleus)

equation_or_definition: boundary_mean / interior_mean (denominator floor 1e-6)
rationale: Per-channel boundary-vs-interior contrast; membrane markers should be greater than 1 for correct cells

equation_or_definition: std of per-slice mean channel intensity across cell Z-range
rationale: Per-channel axial signal stability

equation_or_definition: # unique foreign label IDs encountered across dilation radii r = 1..5
rationale: Local packing density

equation_or_definition: min over neighbors L' of r*(L, L'), the first dilation radius at which L' is contacted
rationale: Approximate gap width to closest neighbour in voxels

equation_or_definition: max over L' of contact_voxels(L, L') / total_shell_voxels
rationale: Dominance of the single most-contacting neighbour

equation_or_definition: bg_voxel_count / total_shell_voxels across all r
rationale: Exposure to extracellular space (high for border or isolated cells)

equation_or_definition: # neighbours with r* = 1
rationale: Count of directly touching partners

equation_or_definition: # neighbours with r* less than or equal to 3
rationale: Count of close-shell partners

equation_or_definition: median over L' of r*(L, L')
rationale: Typical gap width in the neighbourhood

equation_or_definition: std over L' of r*(L, L')
rationale: Heterogeneity of neighbour distances

equation_or_definition: OLS slope of cumulative r*-histogram (cumulative count vs r for r = 1..5)
rationale: How quickly neighbours appear with increasing dilation radius

equation_or_definition: smallest r at which cumulative neighbour count is at least 0.8 * total
rationale: Radius at which 80 percent of neighbours have been contacted

equation_or_definition: V_L / mean(V_{L'}) over neighbours L'
rationale: Size of this cell relative to its neighbourhood

equation_or_definition: std(V_{L'}) / mean(V_{L'}) over neighbours
rationale: Homogeneous versus mixed neighbourhood size distribution

equation_or_definition: V_L / (sum_{L'} c_{LL'} V_{L'} / sum_{L'} c_{LL'}) where c is contact_voxels
rationale: Size ratio weighted by shared contact area

equation_or_definition: # neighbours contacted in the basal third of the cell's Z-range
rationale: Basal connectivity (stratification readout)

equation_or_definition: # neighbours contacted in the apical third of the cell's Z-range
rationale: Apical connectivity

equation_or_definition: 1 - |basal_neighbours INTERSECT apical_neighbours| / |basal_neighbours UNION apical_neighbours|
rationale: Neighbour-identity change from basal to apical (1 = complete turnover)

equation_or_definition: |basal_neighbours INTERSECT apical_neighbours| / total_neighbours
rationale: Fraction of neighbours spanning the full apical-basal height

equation_or_definition: mean p over mask voxels
rationale: Overall reconstruction confidence

equation_or_definition: 10th percentile of p over mask voxels
rationale: Weakest-link confidence

equation_or_definition: std of p over mask voxels
rationale: Intra-cell confidence variability

equation_or_definition: mean p on 1-voxel erosion shell
rationale: Boundary-level confidence

equation_or_definition: mean p on erosion core
rationale: Core confidence

equation_or_definition: prob_interior_mean - prob_boundary_mean
rationale: Positive drop expected for correctly segmented cells

equation_or_definition: V_soft = sum of p over ROI padded by 3 voxels
rationale: Probability mass in the expanded neighbourhood

equation_or_definition: V_soft / |M|
rationale: Probability mass leaking outside the hard mask

equation_or_definition: mean H(p) on boundary shell where H(p) = -p ln p - (1-p) ln(1-p) (natural log, in nats)
rationale: Boundary uncertainty

equation_or_definition: mean H(p) over mask (natural log)
rationale: Global uncertainty within the cell

equation_or_definition: mean ||grad p|| on boundary shell; grad computed by np.gradient on full volume
rationale: Edge sharpness

equation_or_definition: std of ||grad p|| on boundary shell
rationale: Homogeneity of edge sharpness along the surface

equation_or_definition: qc_score = (1/K) sum_{k=1..K} |z_tilde_k| where z_tilde_k = (x_k - median) / (1.4826 * MAD) after auto log1p on right-skewed unbounded features and winsorization at +/- 10; K = 15 (the features flagged in_composite_qc = 1)
rationale: Mean absolute robust z-score across 15 decorrelated QC features; high values flag multivariate outliers

equation_or_definition: Directional composite: mean over available features k of max(z_tilde_k * sign(w_k), 0); contributors: boundary_interior_ratio (w=-1), inertia_elongation (w=+1), skeleton_branches (w=+1), euler_number (w=-1), cross_section_bulge (w=+1), mean_neighbor_size_ratio (w=+1)
rationale: High score flags merge-like cells (elongated, branched, low membrane contrast, high bulge)

equation_or_definition: Directional composite with contributors: area (w=-1), neighbor_count (w=-1), background_fraction (w=+1), mean_neighbor_size_ratio (w=-1)
rationale: High score flags fragment-like cells (small, isolated, high background exposure)

equation_or_definition: (z(prob_edge_gradient) - z(prob_boundary_entropy) + z(prob_boundary_mean)) / 3 using per-feature robust z-score clipped +/-10
rationale: High score = sharp edges + low uncertainty + high boundary probability = confident boundary

equation_or_definition: Directional composite with contributors: apical_basal_area_ratio (w=+1), cross_section_taper (w=+1), inertia_elongation (w=+1), true_sphericity (w=-1)
rationale: High score flags cells with unusual shape relative to the population
